title: Keka integration (ATS & HRMS) | Xobin
text:
About Keka
Keka is a modern HRMS and payroll platform designed to simplify end-to-end employee lifecycle management. It helps organisations plan, attract, hire, onboard and manage talent efficiently through an intuitive and scalable system built for growing businesses.
Why Integrate Keka with Xobin?
Integrating Keka with Xobin lets recruiters embed skill-based assessments directly into the hiring workflow. You can automate assessment invitations, track candidate progress in real time and access detailed performance reports without switching tools. This reduces manual coordination, improves screening accuracy and ensures hiring decisions are based on objective skill data rather than resumes alone.
Steps to Integrate Keka with Xobin
Generate an API key in Xobin
Log in to Xobin and go to
Settings > Integrations
Enable the
Keka HR
integration and click
Generate API Key
Securely copy the generated key for use in Keka.
Install the Xobin app in Keka
Log in to Keka HR and navigate to
Apps / Integrations
Search for
Xobin
and open the app details.
Click
Install
to begin the setup.
Configure the integration in Keka
Paste the API key generated from Xobin when prompted.
Submit
to complete the setup.
Send assessment invites from Keka
Go to
Hire > Candidates
in Keka HR.
Open the candidate profile and click the three-dot menu.
Select
Send Assessment
and choose
Xobin Assessments
Select the assessment and invite the candidate
Choose the relevant assessment, set the invite expiry and click
Send
The invitation is sent to the candidate automatically.
Track assessment status
Monitor invitation status and completion progress directly in the candidate's profile in Keka HR.
Review assessment reports
Once the candidate completes the assessment, results appear in the
Feedback
section.
View Report
for detailed Xobin assessment insights.
Make informed hiring decisions
Use skill-wise analysis and performance data to evaluate candidates objectively and move forward with confidence.
Who is this integration for?
This integration is ideal for recruiters, HR managers and talent acquisition teams using Keka to manage hiring. It is especially useful for fast-growing companies, mid-sized businesses and enterprises that want structured, skill-based screening in recruitment. Teams hiring for technical, functional or role-specific positions benefit from faster shortlisting and improved hiring accuracy.
Capabilities
Features & benefits
One-click app install
Find Xobin in Keka's Apps / Integrations directory, install it and paste your Xobin API key to connect.
Invites from the candidate menu
Use the three-dot menu on any candidate under Hire > Candidates to send a Xobin assessment with an expiry date.
Live status tracking
Invitation status and completion progress are visible on the candidate profile inside Keka.
Reports in the Feedback section
Completed results land in Feedback, with View Report opening Xobin's skill-wise analysis.
Time-boxed invitations
Set an expiry date on each assessment so screening stays inside your hiring timeline.
HR and hiring data in one system
Keka's employee records and Xobin's skill evidence sit side by side for a single view of every applicant.
Answers
Frequently asked questions
Enable the Keka HR integration in Xobin Settings > Integrations, generate an API key, then install the Xobin app from Keka's Apps / Integrations page and paste the key.
